initial_state: Copy the included 378-byte seed-current.bin to data/CURRENT.BIN in each fresh disposable DOS root. It derives from a normal-exit, no-target save (SHA-256 bca6c68b3fa4565e1832602a129fd80fe66968034f2a4897ac061e801d075009) using seed_goes_console.py: initial pwr=15000, pos_x=3000, pos_z=-2000, user_beta=-90. The seed starts the avatar facing the GOESnet console; ship coordinates and target are unchanged. Its lithium charge remains 3, so power can rise during play and the Vimana drive may start after ST.
steps: Copy the pinned data/, modules/, and dosbox.conf into a new disposable directory and verify the reference hashes. Copy seed-current.bin to its data/CURRENT.BIN and verify the seed hash before launch. Do not run against the tracked checkout.

Launch DOSBox-X with that root mounted as N:, switch to N:, cd modules, run NOCTIS.EXE; press Enter if the boot screen waits. The seeded avatar is by the GOESnet input console. Press Home to clear its input line.

Enter PAR MIRACLE and press Enter. Wait for data/GOESFILE.TXT to contain the GOES STARMAP ANALYSIS result; preserve it before another command overwrites the file. The raw 147-byte result is par-miracle.txt.

Enter ST MIRACLE and press Enter. Wait for the LOOKING FOR TARGET result and for the game to consume data/COMM.BIN. The raw 147-byte result is st-miracle.txt. The module's STARTING VIMANA DRIVE text does not by itself establish ship state.

Allow the game to process the target, then press Escape for a normal save/exit. Run extract_current_target.py on data/CURRENT.BIN; require ap_targetted=1 and the saved target fields below. Repeat from a fresh copy using the identical seed. Do not accept a save with ap_targetted=0, even if ST returned success text.
exploratory_runs: An earlier seeded PAR/ST attempt also produced identical target fields (CURRENT.BIN SHA-256 9e0167c6660e5586f4a3350faed16c8e9fdfbc9f8ef19e113ca449d29ffd781b) but was not counted among the two direct repetitions.

A separate ST-success run saved ap_targetted=0 (CURRENT.BIN SHA-256 3f1ed7c92db590d4c1f90e24a4fa63d182e703b859a4cbc28bd207125829a541), apparently because the game had not finished applying the target before exit. It is excluded.
comparison_level: EXACT saved coordinates, class, RGB, spin, radius f32 bits, and raw GOESnet output; TOLERANT starmap double ID; STRUCTURAL on-screen presentation
notes: Both accepted saves agree on every target field, and a third exploratory run agrees as well. Whole-save hashes differ because other state is time-dependent; they are evidence, not golden files. GOESnet PAR displays positive Y by convention while the saved internal Y is negative. The sector origin is inferred by matching DOS's saved coordinates to the native sector function; DOS does not serialize it. The GOESnet files consist of seven concatenated 21-byte fields, without line breaks.
